fm_reference: FM24's 'right-click anyone' standard: any player name anywhere in the UI is a live entity with a full context menu (view profile/club, make offer, scout, shortlist, compare) — no dead references, offers filed from any screen land in the real transfer pipeline, knowledge masking respected.
biggest_gap: Market-target scouting mails are second-class inbox citizens: the interim (50%) and full (100%) watch reports on club-owned targets are filed via plain add_inbox_message (rendered by report_gen._plain — zero actions, no entity pill, no nav button), so the mail that says 'see Transfers > Scouting' is a textual pointer you must follow by hand; only PROSPECT scout reports (cat 'scout') carry the live entity pill. In FM24 the player's name in that very mail would be right-clickable.

history.gap: Built shared/ui/mon_actions.gd (class_name MonActions): one global context-action layer for ANY mon uid — View Profile (routes mine->Squad, league club->Competition profile, FA/prospect/overseas->Transfer Search), View Club, Make Transfer Offer / Approach to Sign, Send Scout, Add/Remove Shortlist, Compare with My Squad (masked-band vs first-team table), Open in Transfer Search. All deal logic = existing market API (make_offer/sign_free_agent/assign_scout_to_target/toggle_shortlist); the transfers screen's offer/contract/scout sheets were MOVED into the component and the screen now delegates, so every screen opens the identical negotiation sheet in place (popup_fitted). Knowledge masking: below Part scouted (50%) the bid/sign action becomes 'Scout First...' and routes to the scout dialog; the menu header shows name/club + scouted%/stage. Affordances: right-click via MonActions.attach/wire_tree + engine-drawn '...' dots (tree cell buttons, flat buttons, labelled pills) for web users. Wired: competition (ui.gd link/cell_link/wire_tree_links => stats centre, leaders, fixture performers, club-profile squads; pokemon profile header gets an Actions pill), transfers (search rows unified + shortlist/rec/agent cards + detail Compare + reveal_search_target deep-link with optional action=offer/sign/scout), inbox (new 'mon' action kind on scout reports, live and archived offer mails), match post-match (opponent rating rows carry uid + menu), academy (Compare with first team), shell (global search results right-click + public toast). i18n: 31 new rows with natural Spanish. Proof: artifacts/actions/driver.tscn (headless, 24/24 checks — stats centre rival: unscouted menu routes offer->scout, real scout assigned via the dialog, grant_knowledge(60) unlocks 'Make Transfer Offer...', confirming the shared sheet files a REAL bid_pending offer that renders in the Transfer Centre out-box; inbox scout report entity button -> same menu -> real shortlist add; compare = target + all 10 squad rows) prints ACTIONS DRIVER OK; artifacts/actions/shots.tscn captures the es-locale menu open in the stats centre, the offer sheet over Competition, the filed offer card + toast in the Transfer Centre, unified '...' search rows with the target preloaded, the inbox entity pill + menu, and the compare dialog. SMOKE OK, TRANSFERS SELFTEST OK, NAV CHECK OK, INBOX OFFER SELFTEST OK; user save/transfers state backed up and restored.

Independent blind judge (fresh driver artifacts/actions/judge_r1_driver.tscn on a scratch career, real shell, GUI run, 40+ live checks, 0 failures). Verified end-to-end in the running UI: (1) competition STATS CENTRE lists rival mons with a visible '...' cell button (web-safe) — clicking it opens the real context menu (header: name/Lv/club + 'Ojeado: 0% · Sin seguimiento'); masking gate correct: below 50% the menu offers 'Ofertar — primero ojear…' and hides the direct offer; shortlist toggled ON via the menu; 'Enviar ojeador…' opened the real Assign Scout dialog (region/travel/JA/home-patch), assignment created, knowledge climbed 0%->53% in 9 sim days; (2) CLUB PROFILE roster rows carry the same affordance; the mon profile header shows an Actions pill, gate OPENS at >=50% (Make Transfer Offer appears, Scout First disappears), the offer sheet (masked valuation P$63K-100K, budget/wage room, package spins, negotiator hint) filed a REAL offer via the UI; menu then shows 'Go to Negotiation' and removes the duplicate offer path (no dead end); (3) TRANSFER CENTRE listed the bid ('Esperando respuesta — plazo', Retirar oferta) and it PROGRESSED in 2 days to 'Paquete acordado' with a live 'Ofrecer contrato' next step + 'Paquete acordado' inbox mail; (4) INBOX prospect scout report carries a live entity pill -> full menu (Tantear para fichar/Enviar ojeador/lista de deseos/Comparar/búsqueda) and Compare-with-squad opened with masked stat RANGES vs exact squad rows. The action layer even followed the target after a rival club signed it mid-test (menu header/club updated — no stale reference). Biggest gap (only material FM24 shortfall found): interim/full watch mails on market targets are plain text with no entity pill or nav action — see verdict field.
